answer: The violet lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the comet is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the nebula of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, capped per identity per epoch.
